reviews.title: Difficult to use Overpriced
reviews.text:
It's possible that this is the hardest to use “phone to fax” app in the store which is puzzling because it’s also the most expensive. Do yourself a favor and try a different app than this one.  It's bulky, not intuitive and has a tendency to take too many pictures of the one page you're trying to send, which forces you to spend time having to edit and delete when you’re really only want to send one page.  There is no confirmation that the fax actually went through. This is a poorly designed  app - apparently written by somebody that really didn’t have to use it.  Frankly, I think the people who developed this ought to be embarrassed for themselves specifically for the amount of money they intend to charge.

Update: Customer service reached out with a disconnected message on the problems I had with the app, which I already explained in my review.  Weak……$8.99 a month is too much money for. App with such low functionality. There are better choices for less money.

reviews.title: Not working. Scam!!
reviews.text:
I paid for an annual subscription for two consecutive years. Unfortunately, I recently discovered that the app is not working properly.

I sent several important documents to a specific agency through the app. After waiting some time, I contacted the agency and was told that they had not received any of my faxes.

To make sure the problem was not on the receiving end, I went to my workplace and tried sending a fax from the app to the fax machine we use at work. I was standing directly in front of the fax machine and confirmed that the document was not received. I then sent a fax using the physical fax machine, and it worked properly. This confirmed that the problem is with the app and that it is not successfully delivering my faxes.

This has caused me significant inconvenience, especially because I relied on your service to send important documents. I paid for an annual subscription for two consecutive years, but the service has not worked as expected, and I feel that I have wasted my money.

I am requesting a full refund for the two annual subscription payments. Please review this issue and let me know how you intend to resolve it.

Do not use this company at all! Don’t even download. They are terrible. 
I downloaded and attempted to send the fee fax 2x. It said it was delivered. It wasn’t. So o deleted it. I never subscribed but proceeded to receive 2 charges for the full subscription in the same day.  Oh it must be a glitch! Wrong. Then less than 10 days later and 2 another subscription charges on that day.  Why would I subscribe 4x to a service.  They denied a refund 2x.  
This company is shady. I never have written a bad review but felt the public needed to know. This is so bad. If you have this app check for duplicate charges. It was nuts!!

reviews.title: Not receiving FAX
reviews.text:
Sent my “fax” number to receive fax. The sender said it will take about 2 hours to receive. Not their issue, but we have waited since 9:30am +/- to receive fax. Contacted the app “contact us” with no number nor email links, only through a q&a with three options. 

 With nothing received, still … it’s a bit frustrating. Needing to have this corrected for title of fax to have send, receive as the focal point. I’ve also paid $8.99 plus tax for this app. 

The other issue I see:  when sending a fax, there are no direct numbers as a confirmation number to say it was received/sent. Only states it was delivered. Wanted a confirmation receipt. Guess it doesn’t operate as such.
